top-hung.name: Top Hung (Awning) Window
top-hung.shortDescription: Top-hinged awning window — ventilates while keeping rain out.
top-hung.description: Top-hinged window that swings outward from the bottom. Excellent for ventilation while maintaining weather protection. The outward swing prevents rain from entering even when open. Ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, and basements where moisture control and airflow are essential.

sliding-window.name: Sliding Window
sliding-window.shortDescription: Smooth horizontal sliding window — wide openings, space-efficient.
sliding-window.description: Horizontally sliding sash window that glides on precision-engineered tracks. Offers wide openings without intruding into interior or exterior space. Ideal for rooms facing walkways, patios, or areas where swing clearance is limited.

casement.name: Casement Window
casement.shortDescription: Side-hinged window — full opening, maximum airflow.
casement.description: Side-hinged window that swings outward for full-width ventilation. Offers unobstructed views, superior energy efficiency due to compression sealing, and easy cleaning from inside. Perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, and any space requiring maximum natural light and airflow.

tilt-turn.name: Tilt & Turn Window
tilt-turn.shortDescription: European dual-mode — tilts for ventilation, turns for full access.
tilt-turn.description: European-style dual-function window that tilts inward from the top for secure ventilation or swings fully inward on side hinges for easy cleaning and emergency egress. Combines superior thermal performance with versatile operation.

hand-cranked.name: Hand Cranked (Casement) Window
hand-cranked.shortDescription: Crank-operated casement — precise control, outward opening.
hand-cranked.description: Casement window operated by a hand crank mechanism that swings the sash outward. Provides precise control over the opening angle, excellent for hard-to-reach locations like above kitchen sinks or counters. Robust mechanical operation with tight weather sealing.

sliding-door.name: Sliding Patio Door
sliding-door.shortDescription: Large-panel sliding door — seamless indoor-outdoor living.
sliding-door.description: Large-panel door system that glides horizontally on heavy-duty precision tracks. Available in 2, 3, and 4-panel configurations. Creates seamless transitions between indoor and outdoor living spaces while maximizing natural light and views.

folding-door.name: Folding (Bi-Fold) Door
folding-door.shortDescription: Multi-panel bi-fold — opens entire wall for indoor-outdoor flow.
folding-door.description: Multi-panel bi-fold door system that folds and stacks to create wide-open passages. Transforms entire walls into open-air spaces. Ideal for patios, restaurants, and any space where maximum opening width and flexible living are desired.

swing-door.name: Swing Entry Door
swing-door.shortDescription: Classic hinged door — single or double, residential & commercial.
swing-door.description: Traditional hinged door that swings open on side-mounted hinges. Available as single or double-leaf, inward or outward opening. Suitable for residential entries, commercial storefronts, and institutional buildings with ADA/AODA compliance options.
